verdict.rationale: Cline's docs describe signing in once to the Cline provider and choosing models directly, with no separate vendor API keys to manage. Free access exists only as periodic free-model promotions with a limited usage quota, and ongoing use otherwise requires buying credits or a ClinePass subscription. missing for 10: a standing, clearly documented free tier tied to a personal account, documented free-tier limits, independent or hands-on confirmation of the sign-in and free-access flow.
